blueprint.label: Phase 5c — First rocket and landing pad (32x32)
blueprint.description: Build only after crafting the silo and landing pad. West chest (4.5,10.5): 50 processing units, 50 low-density structures, 50 rocket fuel. Inserter feeds silo. Put one starter pack into rocket cargo, select New platform, name it and launch. External power inlet (4.5,8.5). Reserve rocket clearance; later use this pad for repeated launches.
